steps.what: Establish actual engineering priorities, capacity and agreed deliverables
Create schedules and check dependencies and assignments in {PROJECT}
Commit the checked schedule in {PROJECT}
Track inventory by checking actual receipts, issues and counted stock against the native asset register {OPS_SYSTEM}, preparing any corrections
Save checked inventory corrections in {OPS_SYSTEM}
Create or use budgets by reconciling explicit quantities and approved costs, checking the resulting budget version in {SPREADSHEET}
Save the checked resource budget in {PROJECT}
Oversee contract obligations and deadlines by reading actual terms and reconciling milestones with current project evidence in {CLM} and {PROJECT}
Manage engineers through direct discussion of priorities, shortages, technical blockers and corrective choices
outputs: human direction and resolved resource issues

steps.what: Send the checked team schedule to the internal team through {PROJECT}

tasks.design: Configure native dependencies in {PROJECT}, inventory exceptions in {OPS_SYSTEM}, cost formulas in {SPREADSHEET} and linked contract milestones from {CLM}. The engineer retains priorities, actual stock verification, contract interpretation and direct leadership; saves and the internal schedule send remain separate human actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate resource records require repeated reconciliation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project, register and spreadsheet views can expose explicit conflicts and totals.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when apparent progress does not meet the actual obligation.

ambition.what: No extra team span or spending authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less resource reconciliation, unchanged team responsibility.

evidence.claim: Native resource views and formulas can support schedules, stock and budgets without automating technical leadership or contract interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary includes resource administration and leadership named in the task; procurement, contract amendment and employment decisions are separate. No spend or contract acceptance is hidden in saving a proposal.

Team members supply actual availability and completion evidence; stores supply transaction ID, part, actual quantity and timestamp; finance supplies approved rates and actual cost lines; contract administration supplies executed version and milestone dates. Missing values require manual reconciliation in the relevant retained steps. Actual stock verification and quantity choices remain counted.
Try native settings first; no new capture feed is assumed. Only dependency handling, view navigation and arithmetic change. Shares are provisional work estimates, not observed baselines.

Each normal author check binds its completed version. s2 checks internal recipients as well as the final schedule; s9 does not silently change it. Any edit requires a new s2 check. Ordinary saves and send retain full time.
unknowns: Existing native views and how often actual records are incomplete.
research_questions: Which reconciliation remains after native dependencies and rate lookups are enabled?

already_counted.description: Priorities and direct team leadership remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Maintain resource views, rate mappings and milestone links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact schedule checked in s2; changes void approval.
Exact corrections checked in s4; changes require recheck.
Exact budget checked in s6; changes require recheck.
Exact schedule and internal recipient set checked in s2; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Cuts are 5.2 schedule, 1.4 inventory view, 4.8 budget and 3.6 obligation-navigation points, gross 15 less 2 upkeep. Low is already configured systems or missing actual records.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop human biobehavioral models and simulations.

steps.what: Define the human biobehavioral model assumptions, measured life-process variables and validity limits
Develop models or computer simulations in scientific modelling software {OTHER}, entering equations, units and parameters and checking solver setup
Execute the checked simulation locally, examine sensitivity and compare output with actual observations
Save the checked model and assessed result version in the controlled research repository {DOCS}

tasks.design: Use native unit checks and reusable solver setup in scientific modelling software {OTHER}. The engineer chooses equations and parameters and tests results against observations; no predictive surrogate replaces scientific validation or controls a live biological process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated solver setup can distract from model assumptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameter tables and setup templates can reduce mechanical model assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Identifiability, biological validity and transfer beyond observed conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing defensible assumptions and recognizing a plausible but invalid model.

ambition.what: No clinical or live process-control authority is added.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated setup, unchanged scientific judgement.

evidence.claim: Scientific modelling tools can reuse setup and check units, but model validity requires independent scientific judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is offline model development and result generation, not collecting biological samples or deploying process control. The local run changes no external or authoritative system; solver runtime is excluded from labour.

Measurement producers supply observation ID, variable, unit, time, calibration and uncertainty in existing records. The engineer checks values manually in s2-s3 when import is unavailable; no new free capture is assumed.

Native templates first. Savings cover setup only, not equation choice, new scientific code, experimental evidence or validation. The normal scientific review in s3 binds the saved model/result version; edits require re-evaluation.
unknowns: How much model setup can genuinely be reused.
research_questions: Can reusable setup reduce entry without concealing changed biological assumptions?

already_counted.description: Assumption choice and scientific validation remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Maintain reusable solver setup and unit checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact model and result version scientifically checked in s3; any edit requires re-evaluation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20% setup reduction on 35 share gives 7 gross points less 1 upkeep. Low is a novel model with no reusable setup.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interpret generated data and choose follow-up experimentation against established process objectives
Design the follow-up experimentation protocol, controls and stopping conditions and check the final procedure
Save the checked follow-up protocol in {DOCS}
Conduct the actual follow-up experiment, operate apparatus and record actual readings and deviations
Write and check the actual experiment record against readings, deviations and the process objective
Save the checked actual experiment record in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure protocol and record headings in {DOCS} to reuse the experiment identity and approved objective. The engineer designs the experiment, conducts it and captures actual readings; only repeated document fields change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protocol and result records repeat experiment metadata.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled templates can reuse identity without inventing observations.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing informative follow-up tests and interpreting deviations.

ambition.what: No additional experiment or faster physical process is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated metadata, unchanged experimental responsibility.

reach.learn: Separate planned conditions from actual observations.

evidence.claim: Controlled experiment templates can reuse metadata while actual observations and scientific choices remain human work.

assumptions: Boundary includes follow-up design, execution and its actual result record. Apparatus operations and real-time readings remain in s4; final document writing is separate in s5. No live equipment commands are automated.

Research records supply experiment ID, prior data version and process objective. The engineer supplies conditions, actual reading, time, unit and deviation during s4, fully counted. Missing digital readings are transcribed and checked manually in s5.

Native templates first. Savings cover metadata only. Existing safety authorization and scientific checks remain within retained protocol work; the proposal does not remove independent authorization where required. Normal completed-document checks in s2 and s5 bind their own saves.
unknowns: Protocol template coverage and current metadata repetition.
research_questions: Can reused identity fields prevent confusion between planned and observed conditions?

already_counted.description: Scientific follow-up choice and actual experimental execution remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact follow-up protocol checked in s2; changes void approval.
Exact actual-result record checked in s5 after experiment; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Metadata reuse saves 2.5 protocol plus 1.3 record points less 0.8 upkeep. Low is templates already filled; physical work and scientific choices unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write protocols, policies and equipment-use documents.

steps.what: Establish the actual equipment instructions, approved policy decisions, standards and maintenance requirements to describe
Write documents describing protocols, policies and standards for equipment use, maintenance and repair in {DOCS}, reusing controlled headings and equipment identity
Check the final document against actual operating instructions, exceptions, repair limits and the intended audience
Save the checked technical document to the controlled draft repository {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure controlled templates in {DOCS} to reuse document identity, equipment metadata and approved headings. The engineer writes the technical content and checks it against the actual equipment instructions; publication through any separate quality workflow is not bypassed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical documents repeat controlled structure and identity fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can remove formatting and repeated metadata entry.
tasks.still_hard: Writing accurate instructions that preserve limitations and exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Technical meaning and responsibility for usable procedures.

ambition.what: No new maintenance policy or automatic release authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less document setup, unchanged technical authorship.

evidence.claim: Controlled templates can reuse document structure and metadata; technical procedure meaning and checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is writing and saving a controlled draft, not approving a policy change or publishing an instruction. A separate required quality review and release remains outside this author's task with no saving claimed.

Document control supplies document ID, revision, equipment ID and approved headings. Engineering and equipment instructions supply the actual procedure, limits and warnings verified in s1. Missing facts require manual source confirmation, not generated procedure text.

Try native templates first. The digest's bounded prose option is not needed for metadata reuse; novel procedure meaning stays human. Final source checking remains full and binds the exact saved version.
unknowns: How much drafting time is actually template setup rather than technical prose.
research_questions: Can native templates reduce repeated setup without carrying obsolete instructions forward?

already_counted.description: Source verification and final technical review remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain controlled templates and metadata mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final technical draft checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20% less time in the 45-share drafting step saves 9 points less 1 upkeep; no technical meaning or review saving. Low is controlled templates already in use.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native resource and document controls while retaining scientific and technical judgement.
reach: Help project controllers and technical writers interpret engineering evidence.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer whose resource and research records clearly distinguish assumptions from actual evidence.
